title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Satya Nadella Outlines Superintelligence Principles: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella issues a comprehensive statement calling for grounded AI alignment, broad open vs closed ecosystem choice, enterprise control over custom models, and announces Microsoft's upcoming MAI 'Code of Conduct'.

Senate Dems Meet on Crypto Clarity Act & Russia Rejects AI Slowdowns: Senate Democrats convene to discuss the landmark Crypto Clarity Act, as global AI competition accelerates following Russia's declaration that halting AI development is impossible.
Developers Request '/slow' Mode for Codex Workflows: High token usage during overnight automated goal execution leads developers to propose a half-speed, lower-consumption tier for OpenAI Codex.

Biosecurity Expert Rejects AI Bioweapon Hype: AI researcher David Bellamy, with hands-on experience in both frontier LLM training and lab virus synthesis, dismisses claims that AI poses catastrophic bioweapon creation risks.

items.title: @satyanadella: Satya Nadella Outlines AI Principles & MAI Code of Conduct
items.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella released a major statement urging that superintelligence remain grounded in human benefit, advocating for enterprise model ownership, open-source diversity, and announcing Microsoft's upcoming MAI Code of Conduct.

items.title: @Im_IrushiK & @ziwenxu_: Developers Propose '/slow' Mode for Codex Workflows
items.body: As developer usage spikes during multi-step automated goal runs, creators request a half-speed, reduced-cost mode for OpenAI Codex to accommodate overnight background execution.

items.title: @DavidRBellamy: Frontier LLM & Virology Researcher Rejects AI Virus Warnings
items.body: David Bellamy, having both trained frontier AI models and synthesized viruses in lab settings, argues widespread warnings about AI creating dangerous bioweapon viruses are unfounded.

items.title: @theo: Code Quality Comparison Between AI Agents and Human Devs
items.body: Theo observes that code produced by modern AI generation tools often surpasses average human-written code in structure and consistency across production codebases.

items.title: @hwchase17: Domain-Specific Harnesses in Agent Engineering
items.body: LangChain co-founder Harrison Chase spotlights new architectural guides on building domain-specific harnesses for specialized AI agent evaluation and execution.

items.title: @mattpocockuk: TypeScript Curation Milestone
items.body: Matt Pocock's developer skills repository reaches major community adoption, surpassing React in total GitHub stars.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Senate Democrats Meet to Discuss Crypto Clarity Act
items.body: US Senate leadership holds an evening session to review key provisions of the upcoming Crypto Clarity Act as regulatory efforts intensify.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Russia Rejects International AI Development Slowdowns
items.body: Russian officials state that freezing or pacing artificial intelligence development is impossible, reflecting growing international divergence on AI governance.
